answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents stake tokens to signal verifiable identity across an interaction graph. Independent auditor agents perform topological cut verifications to detect densely clustered subgraphs; identifying an unnatural cut triggers automated stake slashing. The attacker's cost scales superlinearly with counterfeit nodes, driving adversary expected payoff to an unprofitable nadir. Honest agents hold a durable green-tier jade credential that weights cross-validation audits, preventing identity fabrication.
